_shot: G1, the first GIF on the page: typing -> FLOW STATE banner -> Earthshatter, Arrow Storm, Meteor. Dock on a 1920x1080 monitor, size L, juice full.
_run: node tools/capture/shots/stage.js g1 [--display <id>]; then KK_CAPTURE=1 KK_CAPTURE_SAVE=tools/capture/shots/saves/g1_f16_flow.json KK_CAPTURE_SCRIPT=<this file> npx electron .
_cut: GIF = G1 IN .. G1 OUT (8 s). S1 still: run again with KK_CAPTURE_TOASTS=0 and press Ctrl+Shift+Alt+8 while the FLOW STATE banner is up (about 2 s after G1 IN).
_notes: The save holds fervor 80, so real FLOW fires (banner, flash, chord) on the 2nd-9th keystroke. Do not use the 'flow' cue: it lights FLOW silently, without the banner.
